conceptual_change: Implement a hard-coded gatekeeper function that disables signal execution when ATR_14 > (SMA(ATR_14, 20) + 1.5 * STDEV(ATR_14, 20)), intended to prevent entry during high-volatility regime shifts.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous hypothesis was rejected due to lack of engine implementation. By explicitly defining the volatility filter as a hard-coded gatekeeper function rather than a generic dynamic sizing rule, the logic becomes executable within the existing trading engine framework to mitigate high-volatility regime risks.
